svg.title: Florist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as florist, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A tied bouquet combines a rounded flower and a tulip with separate stems and a single open leaf. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face and round glasses.
